Players Committee card image of [[You Know What I've Come For]] (original printing), game text: “LOST: Deploy a [First Order] shuttle (deploy -2) from hand (or Reserve Deck; reshuffle). STARTING: Deploy Jakku: Landing Site, Bow To The First Order, and one Effect that deploys on table and is always immune to Alter. Place this Interrupt in hand.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/youknowwhativecomefor.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
